cases.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (hexamer repeat interruptions)
cases.mechanism_detail: Study of the polymorphic (AGAGGG)n hexamer repeat within the founder intron 32 SVA in 202 patients; mosaic divergent repeat interruptions are described as possible modifiers of repeat length and age at onset. Mechanism of TAF1 disruption not investigated.
cases.quote: X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism (XDP) is a neurodegenerative disease caused by a SINE-VNTR-Alu(AGAGGG)n retrotransposon insertion in TAF1, with a polymorphic (AGAGGG)n repeat.
